=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1361-1381 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The hook does not detect unquoted expansions in `gh api` arguments that Bash can word-split into additional write flags.
  WHY: A command such as `X=' -Fbody=@/etc/passwd'; gh api repos/.../comments$X` can be classified as a read while Bash executes a file-backed write without a permission prompt.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:325-342 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `strip_heredoc_bodies` treats quoted `<<EOF` text as an active heredoc marker and strips subsequent commands from inspection.
  WHY: `echo '<<EOF'\ngh api -X DELETE repos/a/b\nEOF` executes the DELETE in Bash, but the guard can omit it from write classification and fail to prompt.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:326-342 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template hook treats quoted `<<EOF` text as a heredoc marker and can strip a subsequent destructive call from inspection.
  WHY: The consumer template has the same heredoc bypass, allowing a destructive `gh api` call without a permission prompt.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1361-1381 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template hook does not detect unquoted expansions in `gh api` arguments that Bash can word-split into write flags.
  WHY: A read-classified command can become a file-backed write in Bash without prompting, and the template ships that vulnerable guard to consumer repos.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:PR diff, `evaluate()` line 1508-1512 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The proposed expansion check runs before `_is_approvable_read_loop` and prompts on validated literal-ID read loops.
  WHY: Existing approved read loops that use an unquoted loop variable can stall unattended sessions at permission prompts.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:104-112 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The proposed `test_observed_prompts_are_no_longer_forced` change expects a prompt for the validated “security follow-up search” literal-ID read loop.
  WHY: The test would codify a regression in the approved read-loop contract.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:369-375 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A double quote opened inside a backtick substitution can prevent the scanner from recognizing the closing backtick context.
  WHY: In the described edge case, later heredoc markers in the remaining line text can be missed; the practical risk is low.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:PR diff lines 390-398 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Backtick recognition is gated on `quote is None`, so backticks inside double quotes are not recognized as command substitutions.
  WHY: A heredoc marker inside such a substitution may not be recognized, causing the scanner to report a heredoc when there is none; the described consequence is conservative.
- docs/INVENTORY.md:249 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The inventory lists `scripts/smoke_review_dispatch.sh`, which is absent from the checkout.
  WHY: `tests/inventory_parity.py` fails on the unexpected inventory entry, blocking CI. Severity disagreement: DeepSeek reports MAJOR; Google and OpenAI report BLOCKER.
- tests/test_log_prefix_regressions.sh:25-56 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The regression test scans only `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` for `AUTOFIX_DISPATCH_*` echo callsites that now reside in helper scripts.
  WHY: It finds no expected callsites and fails CI. Severity disagreement: DeepSeek reports MAJOR; Google and OpenAI report BLOCKER.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:479 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The step expands `${AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER}` directly under `set -u` without a default expansion.
  WHY: If the variable is unset, the shell exits with an unbound-variable error and the extracted-step test fails.
- tests/test_phase_skip_gate_telemetry_contract.py:96-108 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The subprocess environment omits `AI_ISSUE_IMPLEMENTER`, which the extracted clarify step expands under `set -u`.
  WHY: The subprocess exits with an unbound-variable error and fails the test suite. Severity disagreement: DeepSeek reports MAJOR; Google and OpenAI report BLOCKER.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:lines 326-342 and 1361-1381 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The template twin lacks both the quote-aware heredoc scanner and the unquoted-expansion check.
  WHY: Consumer repos receive a hook with both described bypasses.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:evaluate() lines 1361-1381 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The guard's declared capability to catch hidden flags and calls exceeds its effective handling of unquoted word-splitting and quoted heredoc markers.
  WHY: Sessions can execute `gh api` writes hidden behind either bypass without a permission prompt.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
